Quiz: Gideon's Victory over Midian Story Quiz
Question: Where was Gideon threshing wheat when the angel of the LORD found him?
OptionB: By a winepress, to hide it from the Midianites
Explanation: Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites, when the angel of the LORD sat under the oak in Ophrah.
